metric: 1 - candidate deviation from intact / lesion deviation from intact, using all 815 motor traces
interpretation: The fixed replacement generalized to new temporal patterns on the original DNge104 pair but did not preserve lesion-sensitive responses to other descending neuron groups. DNa02 has a particularly small lesion effect (0.089% relative model-output error), so its recovery percentage must not be read as a large functional deficit. No biological behavior was tested.
